title: API 570 Training in Pasadena, TX: Piping Inspector Exam Prep
description: Self-paced API 570 exam prep for Pasadena and Bayport piping inspectors: CUI, stainless lines, terminal piping and worked B31.3 examples, with instructor Q&A.
h1: API 570 Training in Pasadena, Texas: Online Piping Inspector Exam Prep for Refinery, Chemical and Terminal Piping
html:
API 570 exam prep for Pasadena piping inspectors

Walk any unit in Pasadena and the piping outnumbers everything else: racks running between the refinery's process units, product lines out to the ship channel docks, transfer lines feeding truck racks, and interconnecting piping that carries feedstock and product between neighbouring plants in the Bayport Industrial District. Somebody has to decide where each circuit is measured, how fast it is thinning and when it must be looked at again. That is the job API 570 certifies, and this page is for the Pasadena, La Porte and Seabrook technicians, operators and engineers preparing for the API 570 Piping Inspector examination.

There is no Atlantis classroom in Pasadena. Atlantis runs API 570 preparation as a self-paced online course in which an instructor answers your questions, so you can work through B31.3 between shifts or during the slack days after a turnaround. API, through its Individual Certification Programs, sets the eligibility rules, administers the examination in person at Prometric test centres and issues the API 570 certification. Atlantis is not an API-approved training provider and does not certify anyone.

The piping systems Pasadena candidates work on

Pasadena's piping falls into a handful of families, and each pushes a different part of the Body of Knowledge to the front.

  • Refinery process piping. Chevron's Pasadena refinery completed a retrofit, the Light Tight Oil Project, that Chevron said would raise light-crude capacity by nearly 15% to 125,000 barrels per day and add jet fuel production and gas oil exports. A change in crude slate and products is exactly the kind of event that sends a piping inspector back to the circuit drawings to ask whether the corrosion rates on record still apply.
  • Polymer plant piping. Chevron Phillips Chemical's Pasadena Plastics Complex on Jefferson Road has produced polyethylene since 1949 and lists high-density and linear low-density grades. Hydrocarbon diluent loops, flare headers and utility systems all fall to the piping inspector.
  • Bayport chemical piping. The district's plants include the Bayport Underwood site, which INEOS Oxide bought from LyondellBasell in 2024 (ethylene oxide, glycols and glycol ethers), INEOS Styrolution's styrene plant on Port Drive and the Celanese Clear Lake acetyls plant in southern Pasadena. Stainless and alloy lines, toxic or corrosive contents and long pipe racks are normal here.
  • Terminal and loading piping. Kinder Morgan's Jefferson Street truck rack in Pasadena moves gasoline blendstocks, ultra-low sulfur diesel, biodiesel, ethanol and jet fuel through nine automated loading bays. Tank manifolds, rack piping and buried or road-crossing sections bring their own inspection questions.

The exam does not ask about any of these companies. It asks how API 570 and its referenced documents apply to the services they run, and the local mix gives you plenty of real examples to anchor each topic.

Damage that Pasadena piping inspectors look for first

Corrosion under insulation on the Gulf side

Insulated carbon steel and stainless lines in a hot, humid, coastal climate are a textbook setting for corrosion under insulation. Learn which operating temperature ranges API RP 571 and RP 574 associate with the worst attack, why cyclic service and damaged jacketing raise the risk, and how API 570 expects an owner to choose locations for insulation removal or screening. The exam tests the logic of selecting suspect areas, so study how the code describes those areas rather than memorising a percentage.

Soil-to-air interfaces and buried lines

Truck-rack and terminal piping often dips under roads or into the ground. API 570 treats buried piping separately, with its own expectations for surveys, cathodic protection records and excavation, and the soil-to-air interface is a favourite question topic.

Stainless steel in chemical service

Chloride stress corrosion cracking of austenitic stainless, especially under insulation, is a real issue in Bayport-style piping, and RP 571 describes when it occurs and how it is found. Polythionic acid cracking and other mechanisms tied to sensitised stainless steels also appear in the recommended practices, so know which services and shutdown conditions bring them on.

Injection points, mix points and dead legs

Wash water, neutraliser and inhibitor injection points, mixing tees and dead legs all receive special attention in API 570. The code describes how an injection-point circuit is defined and where its inspection locations sit; learn that description from the text itself, because questions turn on the definitions rather than on remembered distances. Dead legs, small-bore connections and branches off main headers are the next set of locations that the exam expects you to treat differently from a straight run of pipe.

Worked example: a terminal transfer line

A hypothetical NPS 8 carbon steel line, outside diameter D 8.625 in., carries product at 400 psi design pressure and ambient temperature. The problem gives an allowable stress S of 20,000 psi, electric-resistance-welded pipe with E = 0.85, W = 1.0 and Y = 0.4. Practice numbers only.

Pressure design thickness

Under B31.3 304.1.2, t = PD ÷ 2(SEW + PY) = 400 × 8.625 ÷ 2(17,000 + 160) = 3,450 ÷ 34,320 = 0.101 in. Suppose the owner's structural minimum for NPS 8 is 0.130 in.; it is larger, so it governs. Getting this order wrong is one of the commonest errors on the exam.

Rates and remaining life at one CML

The condition monitoring location read 0.310 in. at the baseline 15 years ago, 0.250 in. five years ago and 0.225 in. today. Long-term rate = (0.310 − 0.225) ÷ 15 = 0.0057 in. per year; short-term rate = (0.250 − 0.225) ÷ 5 = 0.0050 in. per year. Use the long-term figure here, the higher of the two. Remaining life = (0.225 − 0.130) ÷ 0.0057, about 16.7 years.

Next thickness inspection

API 570 takes the lesser of half the remaining life, here about 8.4 years, and the maximum for the piping class in the code's interval table. Classify the line from the fluid description in the question before you read off the maximum; the class is often hidden in a sentence about vapour clouds or flash points.

MAWP of the corroded line

Deduct twice the corrosion expected until the next inspection, here eight years: 0.225 − 2 × 0.0057 × 8 = 0.134 in. Rearranging B31.3 gives P = 2SEWt ÷ (D − 2Yt) = 2 × 17,000 × 0.134 ÷ (8.625 − 0.107) = 4,556 ÷ 8.518 = about 535 psi. The pipe wall still covers the 400 psi design, so the next check is the flange class and any valve ratings on the circuit.

Hydrostatic leak test

B31.3 sets the test at 1.5 × design pressure × the stress ratio. At ambient design temperature the ratio is 1.0, so the test pressure is 600 psi. Expect a variant at elevated temperature where the ratio rises above one.

How Pasadena candidates qualify for API 570

The education and experience combinations are the same for every candidate: one year of piping inspection experience with an engineering or technology bachelor's degree, two years with a two-year degree or certificate (one of them in inspection), three years with a high school diploma and five or more years without formal education. The experience must be recent and gained while employed by or under contract with an authorized inspection agency. Read the details on the API 570 certification requirements page before you apply.

The people who most often follow this route locally are UT thickness technicians who already take CML readings for an inspection contractor, operators and process technicians who join a plant's fixed equipment group, maintenance planners who know the circuits, and San Jacinto College graduates. That college's Central Campus is on Spencer Highway in Pasadena, and its Fixed Equipment Inspection Technology degree includes a Pressure Piping and Valve Inspection course. A course of study is not experience, though, so plan for the working years API requires. If you are still building NDT skills, Atlantis's NDT training for Pasadena covers UT, RT, MT, PT, VT and MFL under ASNT SNT-TC-1A, separately from API exam prep.

Studying for API 570 around Pasadena turnarounds

Piping inspectors are among the busiest people on a turnaround, and the refinery, the polymer plant and the Bayport units do not all come down at once, so contractors can be booked for months in a row. Plan the study in blocks you can finish between jobs:

  • API 570 first, read through twice, with the definitions, interval rules and the inspector's duties marked.
  • API RP 574 next, because it explains how piping is actually inspected and fills in what API 570 states briefly.
  • ASME B31.3 sections for pressure design, examination and testing, worked as calculations, then B16.5 flange ratings.
  • RP 571 mechanisms for your window, RP 577 welding and metallurgy, RP 578 material verification, ASME Section V and IX and the PCC-2 articles listed.
  • Timed practice papers in the closed-book and open-book format, with every uncertain answer sent to the instructor.

Choose the window first, using the API exam schedule, and work backwards from its application deadline. A turnaround can pause the plan; the course simply waits for you.

Other routes to API 570 preparation near Pasadena

Classroom exam-prep courses are offered across the Houston area by commercial trainers; they fit candidates who can leave work for the duration and like a fixed timetable. A college programme builds skills from the ground up over several semesters, which is a career route rather than a last stage before the exam. Large owner-users sometimes coach their own inspectors through the codes. The Atlantis course fits the candidate who needs to study around shifts, wants to repeat the B31.3 calculations until they are automatic, or is preparing for a window some months away. None of these routes changes what API asks for on the application.

Exam day for Pasadena candidates, and sponsorship

Once API approves your application you book a seat through Prometric, which lists test centres in and around Pasadena and greater Houston. The API 570 examination contains 170 questions, 140 of them scored, split into a closed-book part and an open-book part with the code PDFs provided on the computer. You may not bring notes or books. The certification runs for three years, with recertification rules that include continuing education and a web quiz every six years.

A plant or contractor can enrol a group of piping inspectors together; fees are quoted on request through the enquiry link below. Atlantis also performs UT, MT, PT and VT inspection in the US, including thickness surveys on piping circuits, but the course and any inspection work are separate services.

faq.q: Can I take API 570 prep in a Pasadena classroom?
faq.a: Not with Atlantis. There is no Atlantis classroom in Pasadena, and the course is self-paced online with instructor Q&A. You study the codes on your own schedule and send questions when a calculation or clause gives you trouble. The examination is the one in-person step, at a Prometric test centre after API accepts your application.

faq.q: Does API 570 cover the piping at Pasadena truck racks and terminals?
faq.a: API 570 covers in-service metallic and fiberglass-reinforced plastic piping systems used for process fluids, which includes most piping inside refineries, chemical plants and many terminal facilities. Pipelines regulated under federal pipeline rules are a different matter, and the code's scope section explains what it excludes. Read that section carefully, because scope questions appear on the exam.

faq.q: I take CML readings for a contractor in Bayport. Does that count as experience?
faq.a: Taking thickness readings can be part of performing piping inspection activities, but API looks at the whole of your documented role and whether you were employed by or under contract with an authorized inspection agency. Record each assignment, the systems you worked on and what you did, and have a supervisor confirm it. See the API 570 certification requirements for the rules.

faq.q: How much B31.3 do I need for the API 570 exam?
faq.a: Only the parts the Body of Knowledge lists for your window, but those must be learnt thoroughly: pressure design of straight pipe and blanks, joint quality factors, examination requirements, preheat and heat treatment, impact testing and leak testing. Practise each calculation until you can do it without hesitation, because the open-book half rewards speed in finding the table you need.

faq.q: Is stainless steel piping a big topic for Pasadena candidates?
faq.a: For the exam it matters as much as RP 571 and RP 574 make it matter: chloride stress corrosion cracking, polythionic acid cracking and related mechanisms are described there. In Bayport chemical plants it matters more in daily work, because stainless and alloy lines are common. Use local experience to understand the mechanisms, then answer from the documents.

faq.q: Can a Pasadena plant enrol several piping inspectors at once?
faq.a: Yes. An employer can sponsor a group on the self-paced course, and each person studies at their own pace with access to the instructor. Fees are quoted on request. Each candidate applies to API separately, with their own experience record, and API decides on eligibility case by case.

faq.q: Should I take API 510 or API 570 first?
faq.a: Follow your work. If you spend most of your time on circuits and CMLs, API 570 is the natural first certification; if you inspect columns, drums and exchangers, start with API 510. The two share several documents, including API RP 571, RP 577 and RP 578, so the second exam usually takes less new study than the first.

faq.q: Where is the API 570 exam taken for someone living in Pasadena?
faq.a: At a Prometric test centre you choose when you schedule, within the window API has approved you for. Prometric lists test centres in and around Pasadena and greater Houston. Check its current list when you book, and look at the exam schedule for windows and deadlines.
